scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' && node scripts/install-deps.cjs
scripts.build:variant: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --define:process.env.BUILD_VARIANT=\"$BUILD_VARIANT\" && node scripts/install-deps.cjs
scripts.build:unified: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' && node scripts/install-deps.cjs
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.desktop:dist:public: cross-env BUILD_VARIANT=public node scripts/apply-variant.cjs && cross-env BUILD_VARIANT=public npm run build:variant && cross-env BUILD_VARIANT=public electron-builder --win nsis portable --config.appId="com.c2mv.letxipu.desktophf.public" --config.productName="LetXipu Desktop HF" --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.desktop:dist:private: cross-env BUILD_VARIANT=private node scripts/apply-variant.cjs && cross-env BUILD_VARIANT=private npm run build:variant && cross-env BUILD_VARIANT=private electron-builder --win nsis portable --config.appId="com.c2mv.letxipu.desktophf.private" --config.productName="LetXipu Desktop HF Pro" --config=./electron-builder.private.json --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
